note: No earnings conference call held in any of the 8 window quarters (Q2 FY25 to Q1 FY27). Evidence opened: (1) company IR page luxinnerwear.com/investors/presentation lists quarterly investor presentations for FY25, FY26 and Q1 FY27 and no call transcript or recording; (2) Trendlyne LUXIND conference-call index lists calls only up to Q1 FY23 (call of Aug 2022, BSE intimation dated 2022-08-08); (3) Arthneeti Q2 FY26, Q3 FY26, Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 pages each state the company did not publish an earnings-call transcript for the quarter; (4) web search of BSE/NSE filings returned no Reg. 30 conference-call intimation after Aug 2022. Quartr event pages describe themselves as 'combining transcript, slides' (template wording) but expose no transcript or audio. Management guidance therefore exists only in investor presentations and results releases, which PROMISES mode does not treat as a call. Credibility for this name cannot be scored from calls; credibility grade is null across the window.
